purpose: A section heading that lands at the bottom of page 1: LaTeX's club/widow and heading-keep rules move it to page 2.
notes: Where the heading falls is the whole point; compare page 1 bottom and page 2 top.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
